description:
Activate Lazotep Quarry's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing an Illusion, adding {1}.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Lazotep Quarry from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Lazotep Quarry from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
